summary: diagnose: the live #140 T5 self-drive created task PR #150 but validate_shiki failed fast on the HEAD checkout: 'task ... goal_id ... has no matching goal file' (validate_shiki.py:2010-2012). Root cause: _evidence_relatives_for_task synced task+worktree+ledgers but NOT the goal/dag/lock files (it assumed those were already on main). A locally-started goal (created by `shiki run`, never committed to main) therefore had no goal file on the branch.
